# Satohash

Bitcoin document notarization via OpenTimestamps — free, sovereign, verifiable proof of existence. NIP-05 identity, badges, and a 7-language platform.

- [Satohash](https://satohash.io/)
- [API](https://api.satohash.io/metrics.json)
- [Tools](https://satohash.io/tools)
- [Guide](https://satohash.io/guide)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/kitsboy/satohash)
